question: How can the light of consciousness appear concealed and later manifest?
premises: The light of the power of consciousness takes on an appearance of tarnish.
Because of that, it appears concealed at one stage.
Afterward it appears in manifest form.
inference: Concealment and manifestation are modes of appearance of the same consciousness-power, not changes in its essence.
plain_english: For the light of the power of consciousness takes on a kind of tarnish; therefore it appears concealed at that time and later appears in manifest form.
